name: University College Roosevelt
summary: Utrecht University's residential liberal arts college in Middelburg, Zeeland: one English BA/BSc you shape yourself, starting September or February.

ib.text: IB Diploma with at least 30 points, excluding TOK, EE and CAS; IBCP and IB certificates are not accepted. A Diploma taught in English meets the English rule (bilingual IB: English A HL, or English B HL at 6 or 7).

programmes.name: Liberal Arts & Sciences
programmes.ib: Selective: grades, a transcript and up to three referees, then a Kira online assessment (four video and two written answers) in place of an interview.

notes: All students live on campus in UCR housing, about €400 a month for the room plus €150 service costs.
To be considered for a UCR scholarship you must apply by 1 March, earlier than the normal deadline; UCR's page prints no year.
Accepting an offer means paying a €300 non-refundable deposit within two weeks; it is deducted from tuition.
